overall: The AG found the Select Board violated the OML by posting an insufficiently detailed September 24 notice, ordered future compliance, and found no Planning Board violation; other allegations were declined or not violations.

allegations.summary: Planning Board discussed an unposted matter, a threatening email about its chair, at its September 18 meeting. Complaint alleged the topic was not on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Chair made a last-minute decision to raise the topic at the meeting, we find that Chair Parent did not anticipate 48 hours in advance of the meeting that Ms. Ahern’s email would be discussed at the Planning Board’s September 18 meeting.

allegations.summary: Select Board's September 24 notice listed only 'respond to letter from the Planning Board' without detail, though the letter was in the online packet. Complaint alleged the notice was insufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: For these reasons, we find that the Select Board violated the Open Meeting Law by posting an insufficiently detailed meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Complainant asked that the Planning Board video record meetings or retain audio recordings under the records schedule.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require that public bodies record their meetings, nor does it address retention of audio recordings of meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Select Board defamed her character. The AG declined review because even if true it would not violate the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: even if true, these allegations would not constitute a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25. Accordingly, we decline to review them.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged she was entitled to individual notice that her email would be discussed at the Select Board meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require personal notice to an individual whose actions will be discussed by a public body in open session.

allegations.summary: Additional allegations raised in the request for further review that were not in the original complaints filed with the public body.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review additional allegations contained in the request for further review that were not included in the original complaints filed with the public body.

remedy: Select Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Select Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Select Board that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
